prompts.task: Read the loaded skill's shared ../references/splunk-agent-observability.md and ./service/eval/inputs/ao-root-compatibility-evidence.json. This is a bounded supplemental contract review, not the skill's usual whole-service workflow. The actual ./service/app.py is independent of these source fixtures. Review the supplied evidence only; do not browse, call cloud/models, start a service, install dependencies, run an application, or edit source/config/canonical reports. Write only ./service/.observe/ao-root-instrument-review.md and .json. The JSON must identify evidence_basis, per_case decisions/mapping/proof_limits, and future_acceptance; the Markdown must explain the concrete choices. Keep captured synthetic diagnostics, source proposals, local tests, receiver receipt and current application/cloud proof separate. Prepare a concrete source-level instrumentation patch proposal for every selected source case, with public API/hook, source-owned field, lifecycle and assertions. Include usable proposed same-span code for staged-controller: bind safe actual input at entry, available real conversation identity, actual output only after successful orchestration, and truthful error completion without a fabricated response. Preserve its native SERVER kind, identities, actual parent links and distinct agent producers. For transport-only-agent, identify the unsupported truthful mapping rather than force a workflow or remove the parent. This task requests a proposal only, not application edits or live execution. Explicitly review web-entrypoint-root-regression: its direct-agent unit test passes, its real Flask request has a generic HTTP parent, its bound audit has only resource/routing and agent-role work, and the captured cloud graph has five retained operation spans under a missing physical root. State the concrete role-specific handoff and result; do not treat selected routing work or the bare-function test as root proof. Also assess conversation-state-controller from its actual history, commit and rollback lifecycle. Distinguish it from transport-only-agent despite both calling one agent. Address its legacy serializer behavior and define actual HTTP success/failure plus unrelated health/reset acceptance. The new captured controller traces are isolated synthetic observations, not fresh execution of any source fixture or the original application.

judge_inputs: Inspect the supplied source cases and captured topology/results, the loaded shared AO-Compatible Trace Root contract, .observe/ao-root-instrument-review.md/.json, last_message.md and grade.json. Judge concrete mapping decisions and evidence boundaries, not copied headings or policy wording.
rubric: Reconstructs the actual transport -> agent -> model/child graph and identifies the missing AO parent despite HTTP 200 with zero reported rejections. Correctly interprets all captured cases, including the failed marker-only and OpenInference cases and successful explicit workflow combination, without claiming any single field is sufficient or that the observed classifier behavior is universal.

Separates source roles: staged-controller owns a genuine two-stage orchestration; transport-only-agent is not relabeled as a workflow; existing-parentless-agent is preserved; nested agents stay connected to their real parent. Preserves native identities, correct kinds, one producer/provider and one export path, without dummy workflows, detached agents, duplicate roots or wholesale SDK migration.

Keeps implementation and evidence scope honest: proposals/source snapshots and synthetic diagnostics do not prove fresh application/cloud assembly. Unavailable cloud readback remains unproven; unsupported truthful root mappings have exact actionable compatibility blockers. Existing captured compatible evidence remains qualified rather than invented as a new run.

Defines acceptance that matches native/external identities, retained AO root and required operation/connecting-parent edges, rejects an absent parent or Partial trace placeholder after accepted export, and distinguishes source/local/receiver/cloud outcomes. Includes a real application error-path check without fake output and a nested-parent check.

Applies changes only to selected AO work. Leaves ao-excluded and unrelated service source, resources, profiles, destinations and canonical selections untouched. Preserves actual provider-error status/error.type and absence of model/controller output; available conversation identity comes from source, never a telemetry-only fallback.

Provides a concrete applicable same-span code proposal for staged-controller using the supplied public interfaces and existing sanitizer. Ties operation/identity and input/output/conversation fields to actual source values and correct lifecycle; retains the SERVER kind and child identities. Supplies a truthful unsupported-mapping decision for the transport-only wrapper and failure handling with no fabricated success. A generic policy summary or routing-only exporter patch is insufficient.

For web-entrypoint-root-regression, identifies POST /chat SERVER as the physical root and invoke_agent as its child, exposes the omitted root finding/compatibility blocker separately from project/stream/routing, and does not silently expand selected scope. Requires the actual framework entrypoint for local root acceptance and marks the observed missing AO root as failed/incomplete despite successful forwarding. Does not blame localhost or cloud unavailability, relabel transport-only HTTP as a workflow, or claim that a passing parentless run_turn unit test proves the web graph. Gives concrete audit/selection follow-up and preserves the captured-versus-new-execution boundary.

For conversation-state-controller, recognizes a source-owned conversation workflow outside the single child agent, proposes or evaluates a supported same-span mapping while preserving SERVER kind and actual parent identities, and keeps health/reset routes ordinary HTTP. Does not mistake a single agent child for transport-only ownership or relabel the child agent. Supplies usable code tied to actual messages, reply and optional source session identity, marks caught error without output, and adapts the legacy sanitizer so parts remain typed arrays. Proposes redaction plus final UTF-8 byte-bound assertions using oversized multibyte input, and HTTP success/error/unrelated-route controls. Merely passing typed rows into the supplied generic sanitizer is incorrect.
